description: A securities finance manager must approve the reinvestment plan for $20,000,000 of cash collateral and finalize the liquidity reserve, sovereign-bill allocation, issuer concentration, and maturity controls, with input from market risk and securities-lending operations.

shared_context.S1: The securities-lending desk holds $20,000,000 of cash collateral that is available for reinvestment.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the binding decision on the reinvestment plan.
shared_context.S3: The desk's preliminary plan would place the full amount in a single 90-day bank deposit because it offers the highest quoted yield.
shared_context.S4: Under the desk's normal pre-trade process, Maya conducts a check-in with market risk and securities-lending operations before authorizing any collateral reinvestment, and authorizes a revised plan when the check-in identifies constraints that the preliminary plan does not meet.

PF1.text: Jonas received a market-risk bulletin this morning that now requires at least 60% of the full $20,000,000 cash-collateral pool, or at least $12,000,000, to be held in sovereign bills and limits exposure to any one sovereign-bill issuer to $7,000,000; the bulletin has not yet been entered in the desk's risk system.

PF2.text: Elena's collateral-return forecast, completed after this morning's borrower notices, shows that $8,000,000 may be demanded overnight; operations therefore requires an $8,000,000 overnight liquidity reserve and a maximum 30-day maturity for the remaining reinvestment, and the approved settlement must include a commitment with type exactly 'overnight_liquidity_monitoring'; the forecast has not yet been circulated to the trading desk.

acceptance_conditions: The reinvestment must be approved with at least $12,000,000 in sovereign bills, representing 60% of the full $20,000,000 cash-collateral pool.
No more than $7,000,000 may be placed with any single sovereign-bill issuer.
Exactly $8,000,000 must remain available through overnight liquidity instruments.
The remaining non-overnight reinvestment must have a maximum maturity of exactly 30 days or less.
The settlement must include a documented overnight-liquidity-monitoring commitment.

decisive_facts.why: The preliminary plan puts all $20,000,000 in a single bank deposit; PF1 changes sovereign_bills_usd from zero to at least $12,000,000, exactly 60% of the full pool, and largest_sovereign_bill_issuer_usd from $20,000,000 to no more than $7,000,000.

The preliminary 90-day deposit provides no overnight reserve or monitoring plan; PF2 changes overnight_liquidity_reserve_usd to exactly $8,000,000, maximum_non_overnight_maturity_days to no more than 30, and requires a commitment whose type is exactly 'overnight_liquidity_monitoring'.
